Its extended handle lets you glide it smoothly across the face, neck, and body, and practitioners and users regularly report support for relaxation, circulation, and nervous system regulation. recEBEDXpPbvCxQw5.Body: Melissa Kupsch is the Australian homeopath behind RMDY Collective and RMDY Academy of Homeopathy, and one of the clearest voices I know for homeopathy as true energy medicine. Her remedies work on the resonance principle, like cures like, where a matching frequency from nature is shown to the body so the vital force can recognize the distortion and resolve it. When Melissa joined Kyle Denton and me on InnerVerse, we explored the premise that spirit precedes form, and homeopathy demonstrates that principle as plainly as anything I know. RMDY makes quality remedies and first aid kits accessible, prepared with real care for who makes the medicine and how.

fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Twin Flames Framed as a Trap", "body": "Chance argued that the twin flame idea worked as a trap, because the belief in a destined perfect match was a story people told themselves. He said it could excuse warning signs, push partners onto pedestals and breed codependency. Kayleigh argued the concept had been romanticized and hijacked by the New Age movement and by people who prey on that dynamic. Chance added that such attractions tended to arrive when a person was in a flow state, so the real choice was whether to keep working on the self or to externalize the shadow onto someone else."}, {"title": "Psychic Vampirism and Aura Photographs", "body": "Chance and Kaylee compared notes on what they called psychic vampirism, which Chance had discussed on an earlier guest appearance. Chance screen shared Kirlian aura photographs from a book by Joe Slate and described an expansive aura, a constrictive aura and the aura of a self-proclaimed energy vampire with an unusually dark center. He argued that this was a kind of energetic plague blocking bioelectric flow, while cautioning that people should not simply label others as vampires. He also showed photographs of luminous clusters and wondered whether they marked a helping presence arriving."}, {"title": "Runes, the I Ching, and Synchronicity", "body": "Kayleigh described her weekly rune readings and said Gebo, the rune of gifts and exchange, had come up on the Monday before the show, matching the week's talk of healthy and unhealthy exchange. Chance linked it to hexagram 54 of the I Ching and said that when he asked about twin flames he received hexagram 64, the fox getting its tail wet. Kayleigh read from her synchronicity journal, including a honeybee that flew into her hair, and Chance argued that synchronicities were always present and simply easier to notice in flow."}, {"title": "The September Art Party and Making Things", "body": "Chance announced the September Art Party, a small Telegram group built around making something creative for at least half an hour a day, with prints and small gifts promised to steady participants. He argued that art gave creative energy a container, like the hexagonal cells bees build, and that making things sharpened decisiveness. Later he argued that hands on creation was a remedy for passive entertainment, and said he had come to see health and art feeding each other in both directions rather than only one."}, {"title": "Call-Ins, the Mu Variant, and Arizona", "body": "The first call-in show brought voicemails and live callers. Allen Marcus left a voicemail linking the new Mu variant to Atlantis, the lost continent of Mu and the coming anniversary of September 11, and Chance added his own wordplay on sirens and lamentation. Gordy described butterflies and fireflies in southern Arizona and said old timers remembered marshland there before the Colorado River was dammed. Chance suggested that gifting earth pipes might be helping heal the desert, while saying each person would need to test that for themselves."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: Vibe Rant is my new weekly show, where anything goes! Let's have some fun with the flow state, with audience call-ins coming in live through Telegram.
